localStorageNote.title: Local storage.
localStorageNote.body: Your chiefs are stored in this browser only. They are lost if the browser cache is cleared. Export a backup regularly.

page.title: Settings
page.subline: Manage your data, sync, chief settings and appearance

about.summary: Track your Whiteout Survival progress: buildings, heroes, chief gear, experts, pets, troops, research, alliance tech, resources and your planner. Everything is stored in this browser, with optional sync to your own cloud storage.
about.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Century Games. Whiteout Survival is a trademark of Century Games.

sync.title: Sync across devices
sync.description: Keep your chiefs the same on your computer and your phone. Sync is optional and free.

chiefSettings.title: Chief settings
chiefSettings.description: Apply to every chief. Saved at once.
chiefSettings.footnote: Changing an option inside a calculator does not change these defaults. The Furnace display only changes how a level is written, never the level itself. Adding or deleting a chief never resets these settings.

fullLevelLabels.label: Show full level labels
fullLevelLabels.description: Shows the sub level on the Furnace, for example FC 5-2 instead of FC 5, in the sidebar, on Overview and on Buildings. Other buildings already show their full label.

hideMaxed.label: Hide maxed items
hideMaxed.description: Hides buildings, heroes, pets and experts that are at their top level. Each list keeps a Show maxed filter, so nothing is lost.

useBonuses.label: Apply my Bonuses totals
useBonuses.description: New calculators start with the construction speed percent from the Bonuses page. A calculator can still change it for one run.

showSpeedups.label: Show speedup minutes
showSpeedups.description: Shows the speedup minutes needed under the time in each calculator result.

showEventPoints.label: Show event points
showEventPoints.description: Adds the event points line to calculator results that return it.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Pick how the app looks. Saved with your data.
appearance.themeNote: System follows your device and is {current} right now. This choice is part of your backup.

management.title: Data management
management.description: One backup file holds every chief and your settings.

export.title: Export data
export.description: Download a backup file of all your saved chiefs. File name: <file>{fileName}</file>. The date is your local day.

import.title: Import data
import.description: Upload a previously exported file (.json). It is checked first, then you choose Merge or Replace and see what changes. Nothing changes until you confirm.

reset.title: Reset all data
reset.warning: This will delete all chiefs and reset your chief settings and theme. You can undo for 10 seconds, so export a backup first if you want to keep a copy.

chiefs.title: Chiefs
chiefs.description: Create, rename, edit and delete chiefs on their own page. Export, import and reset apply to all of them.

importDialog.title: Import backup
importDialog.checks: The chiefs list was found and {count, plural, one {{amount} entry was} other {{amount} entries were}} read. Nothing has been saved yet, so your current chiefs are untouched.
importDialog.howToApply: How should the file be applied?

modeNotes.merge: Adds chiefs that are new and keeps the newer copy of a chief that is in both. Chiefs only on this device stay. Your settings stay.
modeNotes.replace: Removes every chief on this device and loads the file as it is, including its settings. Use this to restore an exact copy.

results.kept: Kept the copy on this device

importDialog.undoNote: Undo stays available for 10 seconds after the import.

resetDialog.title: Reset all data
resetDialog.question: Delete all {chiefs} from this browser?
resetDialog.settingsNote: Your Light, Dark or System choice returns to System. Chief settings return to their defaults. The active chief is cleared.
resetDialog.undoNote: Undo stays available for 10 seconds after the reset. Export a backup first if you want a file copy that stays.

backup.notJson: The file is not valid JSON. Nothing was changed.
backup.noChiefsList: The chiefs list is missing. Nothing was changed.
backup.duplicateId: Two chiefs share one id. Nothing was changed.

chief.badStateNumber: Chief {position} has a state number that is not a whole number.
chief.badCoreEvent: Chief {position} has an unknown Core event.
chief.badUnlock: Chief {position} has an unlock setting that is not a server day of a known area.
chief.badPack: Chief {position} has a pack setting that is not on or off.

settings.notObject: The settings are not an object.
settings.badTheme: The theme is not Light, Dark or System.
settings.uiNotObject: The interface settings are not an object.

region.title: Language and region
region.description: Pick the language and how numbers and dates are written. Saved with your data.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Names of heroes, items, buildings and research come from the game data and stay in English for now.
